newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu ends flat, market focuses on T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu ends flat, market focuses on T-bills.

text.p: 1415 GMT - The Romanian leu currency closed almost unchanged at 7,060/100 to the dollar on Tuesday on a dollar flooded interbank market, traders said.
* They also said the market was over liquid both in dollars and lei and would see few changes for the rest of the week.
* On the money market, traders were focused on the auction for three-month T-bills, whose annual yields were about 100 percent.
Short-term prices hovered near 95 percent on Tuesday. Lower rates were expected due to an over liquid money market, traders said.
* Leu rates at currency retail shops hovered at 6,820/7,000 to the dollar.
